scope: module_loaded/1 over actual published per-Isolate modules, without autoload or atom creation.
adaptations: Native module_loaded_1 requires an atom and returns true only for current code with no pending on_load. The additive profile queries its owned published module list; native exports alone are not treated as loaded modules. The actual preloaded erlang module is visible. on_load remains refused at admission, with an explicit compiled rollback witness.

Charge the boundary and each module visited. Return immediate booleans or badarg without allocation, GC, pinning, new atoms or code leases. Work denial remains a resource outcome, not false or badarg. Namespace and code lifetimes rely on the existing serialized Engine ownership.

Tests cover actual compiled calls, native direct entry under allocator/quota denial and full heap, all work prefixes, unchanged namespace/source/heap, badarg classes, missing/empty/boolean atoms, separate live World scopes, unload/reload, refused on_load admission, balance and shared-worker exact-threshold/one-below/reuse/reclamation. Independent OTP checks loaded/preloaded/absent and unload/reload behavior.
